description_en: Uploads data multiple times to the IoT blockchain trusted application system. The uploaded data must be signed by the IoT device
description_zh: 用于向 IoT区块链可信应用系统多次上传数据，并且上传的数据必须由 IoT设备端进行签名
kebab_example: aliyun ltl attach-data-with-signature --biz-api-version 1.0.0 --key 0001_HB5jyvZWzwcM0000_0X00_80aa976ac4d64a97bd45c71a509d0000 --value '某公司某业务数据。' --product-key HB5jyvZWzwcM0000 --iot-auth-type ID2 --iot-id 1833297615720000 --iot-id-service-provider g9R4ghe0000 --iot-data-digest 94894989498FDDABD51698BD1A49BF1AFB0AA94FAA8DB65A689164BEED000000 --iot-signature '2~2~192ADFB498AA0000~1579198300000~J8E891NAgAhwHBHm8000000/hnswr698HSb09ahS8709bn9s03jg98u4jg000000' --iot-id-source 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachDataWithSignature

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the data key
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
The IoT authentication method.
ID2: Alibaba Cloud Link ID²
parameters.help_zh:
IoT认证方式。
ID2：阿里云Link ID²
parameters.name: iot_auth_type

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the IoT device
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the IoT device service provider
parameters.name: iot_id_service_provider

parameters.help_en:
The digest of the IoT data value.
Encode the value data in UTF-8.
Perform a SHA256 operation. The result is 32 bytes of data.
Convert the result to a 64-byte string in uppercase characters
parameters.help_zh:
IoT数据Value摘要。
Value数据UTF-8编码。
SHA256运算，结果为32字节数据。
转换为64字节字符串格式（大写字符）
parameters.name: iot_data_digest

parameters.help_en:
The IoT device data signature.
Use the IoT device security SDK to sign the data
parameters.help_zh:
IoT设备数据签名。
使用 IoT 设备安全 SDK 进行签名
parameters.name: iot_signature

parameters.help_en:
The IoT device service provider. Valid values:
1: open platform.
2: IoT platform
parameters.help_zh:
IoT设备服务提供方。
1：开放平台。
2：物联网平台
parameters.name: iot_id_source

parameters.help_en:
The business ID of the user. The business ID must be unique for the same key. The value is a 64-character string. Valid characters: [0-9,a-f,A-F].
If this parameter is not specified, the latest data for the current key is returned
parameters.help_zh:
用户业务ID，同一个Key，业务ID必须唯一。格式为64字符，合法字符范围[0-9,a-f,A-F]。
如果不包含该参数，则返回当前Key最新数据
parameters.name: business_id

Data.description_en: A redundant parameter. Ignore this parameter

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
Message.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
Message.example: The system is busy. Please try again later.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
